_comment: Tier-2: shallow-water gravity is the SCALAR ProcessInfo entry GRAVITY_Z — not a GRAVITY vector and not a nodal variable; the elements read only that. Pitfall (kratos.shallow_water #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). KM.GRAVITY_Z resolves and its repr identifies it as 'component 2 of GRAVITY'; ProcessInfo.SetValue(GRAVITY_Z, 9.81) reads back 9.81. The wrong route the claim names is tested too: reading GRAVITY_Z off a node that has not had GRAVITY added raises RuntimeError 'This container only can store the variables specified in its variables list. The variables list doesn't have this variable:GRAVITY_Z', so gravity is genuinely not a nodal quantity here. The claim's own failure mode is silent (g=0, nothing moves), which is why the location of the value is the only signal. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
